business_domains.description: This domain encompasses all functionality related to user identity, authentication, and profile management. It handles user registration (creating new accounts), sign-on and sign-off (authentication/session management), and editing of personal information including contact details (name, address, phone, email). It also manages user preferences such as language preference, favorite category, and banner display options. The bounded context covers the full lifecycle of a user account from creation through updates, and encompasses the authentication credentials and profile settings stored separately in the database (signon, account, profile, and bannerdata tables). This domain is self-contained with its own service and data access layer for account-specific operations.

This domain covers the product catalog browsing and search capabilities. It manages the hierarchical organization of the store's offerings: categories at the top level, products within categories, and specific items (SKUs) within products. It supports browsing categories, viewing products by category, viewing individual product details and their available items, checking item availability/stock status, and keyword-based product search. The domain also encompasses inventory tracking for items. Additionally, it covers supplier information associated with items. This bounded context is responsible for all read-oriented catalog operations including listing and searching, and represents the core product information that the entire store is built around.

This domain manages the temporary shopping cart that customers use before committing to a purchase. It handles the complete cart lifecycle within a user session: adding items to the cart (with stock availability checks), removing items, updating item quantities, viewing the current cart contents and subtotal, and transitioning to the checkout process. The domain maintains per-session cart state including the collection of cart items, each holding a reference to a catalog item, its quantity, and computed total price. This bounded context is distinct from Order Management as it deals with the pre-purchase, transient state of a customer's intended purchase before it becomes a committed order.

This domain handles the complete order processing workflow from checkout through order fulfillment tracking. It covers creating new orders (converting a shopping cart into a committed order), capturing shipping and billing address information, recording payment details (credit card type, number, expiry), managing individual line items within an order, updating inventory upon order placement, tracking order status, retrieving order history by customer, and viewing specific order details. The domain uses a sequence generator to assign unique order IDs. This bounded context represents the transactional core of the e-commerce application, managing the permanent record of customer purchases and the associated business operations like inventory deduction.
